title: Joy you can both rely on

captions.emotions: Feeling the steadiness of your closeness

meaning: Care can give you a dependable sense of closeness when joy takes a repeated form available to you both.
text: Closeness can feel dependable because some things are pleasant to repeat. In the physical position of Anahata, the Empress turns attention into comfort, prepared food and time for two. The Sun in energy gives a wish to share pleasure openly: you want the other person to feel good and enjoy their living response. The Emperor in emotions brings a sense of support with a recognisable structure. Warmth feels especially convincing when you can find it again, and a good evening does not depend entirely on a rare lucky coincidence. Tenderness acquires a place in your shared life.

You might develop a custom of weekend breakfast on the balcony. One person brings the chairs out, the other carries the food, and even half an hour becomes an anticipated meeting. **Repeated joy can be a form of dependability.** Breakfast need not be perfect: sometimes it is very simple, and the weather keeps you indoors. What matters is the continuing practical expression of wanting to see each other. Care becomes recognisable without needing a grand new demonstration of love each time.

The difficulty is guarding the familiar joyful picture more firmly than the meeting itself. A different morning then feels like support disappearing. You try to restore smiles and the usual arrangement although someone needs something else today. Care becomes a compulsory scene. Dependability keeps its warmth while the shared custom can change without taking away your possibility of closeness.
